headline: Bitcoin falls more than 20% so far in November
summary: US-listed spot bitcoin ETFs have recorded seven consecutive sessions of outflows, while bitcoin has fallen more than 20% so far this month.
why: Spot bitcoin ETFs are regulated funds that hold the cryptocurrency, so their flows show institutional demand and influence bitcoin's price.
why_moved: Seven straight sessions of outflows from US-listed spot bitcoin ETFs reflect ongoing selling by fund investors.
original_headline: Bitcoin retrocede más de 20% en lo que va de noviembre
